Dear teenager,

We know you spend a lot of time on your phone. We're not here to lecture you about it.

The same phone you scroll on can design a poster, edit a short film, build a website or test a business idea. People your age are doing it right now. Most of them just needed someone to show them where to start.

So we're building that place. Short lessons, real projects, somewhere to keep your work, and people who want to see you win.

You don't have to know what you want to be yet. Start with what you're curious about. We'll figure out the rest together.

Rooting for you,
MyDearTeenager

Contrast makes things easy to read

Can you read me?

Contrast is how much two things stand apart. Dark text on a light background is easy to read. Light on light disappears.

Dear parent,

You've probably wondered whether all that screen time is doing your child any good. So did we.

MyDearTeenager is our answer: a structured, moderated place where time online turns into skills you can actually see.

shieldTeens under 18 can only join once a parent or guardian confirms it.

What 20 minutes a day could build

20hours of practice
4finished projects

Example only: 5 days a week over a 12-week school term, with a project roughly every 5 hours of practice. Real results depend on the course.

Questions teens and parents ask.

See all questionsarrow_forward

When does MDT launch?expand_more

We're building it now. Everyone on the waitlist hears the launch date first.

How much will it cost?expand_more

We'll share pricing before launch, and waitlist members will hear about it first.

Is it safe for my child?expand_more

Safety is part of the design from the start. Under-18s need a parent or guardian to confirm their account, the community is moderated with clear rules, and anyone can report something that feels wrong. Read how we keep MDT safe.

Does it replace school?expand_more

No. MDT sits alongside school and adds the practical skills school doesn't always have time for.

Helping teenagers get good at something real, with the people who love them cheering them on.

With love, MDT
